Name: Better Junimos Forestry Redux
Author: Afropenguinn
Description:
[size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8711/8711-1620835492-419642025.png[/img][/size]
[b][size=4]4 Different Modes[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Normal mode[/size]
[*][size=3]Crops Mode[/size]
[*][size=3]Forest Mode[/size]
[*][size=3]Orchard Mode[/size]
[*][size=3]Swap between different modes by left clicking a Junimo Hut[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Chop Wild Trees[/size]
[/b][list]
[*][size=3]In forestry mode, Junimos will chop all fully grown wild trees[/size]
[*][size=3]This includes any modded trees[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Collect Dropped Items[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Any items left on the ground will be picked up by the Junimos in any mode[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Collect Seeds[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Junimos will pick up any wild tree seeds when they are in the way while in crop, forest, and orchard mode[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Fertilize Trees[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Junimos will fertilize wild trees if you give them wild tree fertilizers in any mode[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Clear Debris[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Junimos will clear debris such as twigs, rocks, and weeds in any mode[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Harvest Fruit Trees[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Junimos will harvest fruit from fruit trees in any mode[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Hoe Dirt[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Junimos will hoe dirt when they have seeds to plant in crops mode[/size]
[*][size=3]Junimos will hoe dirt around wild trees to make sure they can grow in forest mode[/size]
[*][size=3]Junimos will hoe dirt around fully grown fruit trees to make sure they can grow in orchard mode[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Plant Wild Trees[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Junimos will plant wild trees in a pattern such that they can grow properly in forest mode[/size]
[*][size=3]While in forest mode, Junimos will also plant any crops they can between wild trees[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Plant Fruit Trees[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Junimos will plant fruit trees in a pattern such that they can grow properly in forest mode[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Clean Hoed Dirt (optional)[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Junimos will clean up any hoed dirt they don't need at the time[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Clear Grass (optional)[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Junimos will harvest grass[/size]
[*][size=3]Any hay from harvested grass that can't fit in your silos will be stored in the Junimo Hut[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Junimos will never get rid of an ungrown crop[/size]
[*][size=3]Junimos will never chop down a fruit tree[/size]
[*][size=3]Junimos will never chop down a wild tree with a tapper on it[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8711/8711-1620835500-986425414.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Requires SMAPI[/size]
[*][size=3]Requires Better Junimos. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2221]Download from Nexus[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ if installed (recommended)[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://github.com/skistad-studios/BetterJunimosForestryRedux]Source Code Available[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8711/8711-1620835473-170495581.png[/img]
Post a comment. If it's a bug, go to [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url], get a link to your log, and add the link to your comment.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8711/8711-1620835466-1733467954.png[/img]
MIT LICENSED
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]This means you are free to update it or branch it into a new mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Credit is nice, but not required.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8711/8711-1620835485-139796296.png[/img]

Fixed being able to access huts from maps they weren't built on.
